notes: Lase targets, safe-haven intel, smoke over the cities

In the 3D view, ◉ Lase turns on a laser designator once major combat is over: tap a target or any spot on the ground and call in 155 mm HE, laser-guided Copperhead rounds or 120 mm mortars from units in range. Each mission shows the civilian risk first, and the rounds really land: buildings fall, people may die, smoke rises
Drones now box known enemies in red on the drone camera and the map: fighters, technicals and mortar teams moving through the streets and in the open. The drone targeting overlay is on by default

Intel turns up reports of insurgents sheltering in schools, mosques and hospitals. Some are true and some are planted. Strike one and you find out which, with heavy civilian casualties and a city in uproar if it was bogus. Drones can watch a site overnight to firm up the confidence before you decide
Smoke and fire now rise from buildings that were hit and from burning streets in restive cities, on the map and in 3D
